pretreatments.description: Acid pretreatment using 5% (w/v) HCl solution, processed in 1 L Corning® bottles at varying temperatures and hydrolysis times (experimental conditions optimized via CCD), resulting in sugar recovery yields up to 21.06 g/L with 0.85 regression coefficient, followed by secondary optimization for methane production using HCl as catalyst.

Acid pretreatment using 5% (w/v) H2SO4 solution, processed in 1 L Corning® bottles at varying temperatures and hydrolysis times (experimental conditions optimized via CCD), resulting in sugar recovery yields up to 11.82 g/L with 0.86 regression coefficient, followed by secondary optimization for methane production using H2SO4 as catalyst.
